title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E2 — Homecoming-Part 1
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E3 — The Homecoming-Part 2
Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E1 — Lucille Ball, Ed Sullivan, Osmond Brothers
Lucy & Flips are two halves of a horse; the whole cast portrays Peanuts characters; Geraldine & Lucy are car hops at the drive-in.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E2 — Joan Rivers, George Gobel
Flip does the shell game; Joan does stand-up and plays a cabdriver; Freddie Johnson buys jewelry from Gobel & Rivers.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E5 — George Carlin, Pat Boone & Family, Sugar Ray Robinson
Flip sells ice cream; Flip & Carlin do a TV news spoof; Boone intros his family and the cast does a "To Tell A Lie" panel show sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E6 — The Supremes, Willie Tyler & Lester, David Frost
Flip plays a huckster; the Supremes join Flip & Frost for a secret agent and haunted castle skits; Willie Tyler does ventriloquism.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E12 — Merry Clayton/Rev. Jesse Jackson
Merry Clayton, top back-up singer who emerged a star, sings "Grandma's Hands.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E13 — Chester Himes/The Dells
Author Chester Himes is welcomed back from self-exile in Europe on this show devoted primarily to his writings. Actor Al Freeman Jr., who reads from Himes' autobiography, and The Dells, who sing several of their hits, join the welcome.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E15 — The Science Project
When Frieda gets sick and can't make it to the science fair, Webster has to come to the rescue.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E16 — The Gospel Truth
Webster inadvertently books a gospel group instead of a rock band for a school party.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E17 — The Visitor
Webster's pen pal is an adult butler from England, and he visits to meet Webster in person before he dies.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E1 — Another Ballgame
After the untimely death of a young boy's parents, he is sent to live with his father's best friend.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E18 — My Guy
A high school nerd out to woo Tia turns to Tamera for help in updating his image, but when his makeover is complete, Tamera realizes she wants to keep him for herself!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E19 — Double Dutch
When a girl from Tia's old neighborhood challenges her to a double Dutch jump rope contest, Tia becomes obsessed with winning.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E20 — Inherit the Twin
Tia and Tamera wind up in student court, where the two boys who are supposedly defending them wind up dissing them instead.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E21 — Slime Party
Tia and Tamera audition for a game show, where their opponents are famous TV twins Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E22 — Guardian Angel
The spirit of Ray's late wife returns to help Tamera make a tough decision, and Ray to get on with his life.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E12 — All Grown Up
Moesha and Hakeem reminisce about their friendship and wonder if it could be developing into something more.
